Strong US jobs data fuelled fears of prolonged higher interest rates, pushing Treasury yields higher and triggering a broad market decline. Analysts expect volatility amid global and domestic uncertainties.

title: Real Estate vs equities: Why wealthy investors are increasingly choosing bricks over stocks

Experts say infrastructure-led growth, improving transparency, tangible ownership, and predictable appreciation are making premium property an attractive complement to equities in diversified portfolios.

title: Dollar firms after strong US jobs data, pushes yen through 160 level

Nonfarm payrolls exceeded expectations, boosting the dollar against the yen, which faces pressure near the 160 barrier.  Geopolitical tensions and safe-haven demand further supported the dollar's rise.

title: D-Street ends another week in the red amid lack of triggers
description: Indian stock markets closed lower on Friday, marking a second consecutive weekly decline. Investor sentiment turned cautious following the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy announcement. Analysts suggest the Nifty may trade within a range in the near term. Foreign investors continued their selling spree, while domestic institutions provided support.

title: FPIs get tax relief on gilts, ease of Investment
description: In a strategic step to lure foreign investment, India has eliminated taxes on capital gains and interest for overseas investors in its government bonds. This change, set to take effect on April 1, is part of an ordinance aimed at enhancing the appeal of Indian sovereign bonds and fortifying the strength of the rupee.

title: Nazara Technologies allots 1.82 crore warrants, gets Rs 118.5 crore in upfront payment
